feedback: The candidate implements the recommended changes from the previous feedback: base_speed increased to 0.75, kd increased to 0.2 for better damping, ki kept low at 0.02 to avoid integral windup, kp at 0.5 to maintain soft proportional response, and line_loss strategy changed to 'search_left' to improve recovery from line loss events. Sensor weights remain softened at [-0.35, 0.45, -0.35] to avoid overcorrection. Although no telemetry data is yet available to confirm the effectiveness of these changes, the rationale is well-founded and addresses the main stability and recovery issues identified previously. I recommend running a development race with this candidate to collect telemetry on steering oscillation and line loss events to verify these improvements. If oscillations or line loss issues persist, consider further tuning kd or adjusting sensor weights magnitude or asymmetry.
